note: Synthetic replay for an order comment without a size (c019, c106) and for replies from the wrong customer. Comments, users and cards come from data/comments/ (c019 Founder-approved, c102/c106 template). Replay with fixtures (the default, not --no-fixtures): the fx- cards keep the labels worker from labelling these comments, so no model is called, and the orders worker acts on the hand-written lb- labels. 'expected' is what the orders worker leaves behind: final state and variant per order, message_out templates per thread in order.
